title: Retry logic breaks on new 429 slow_down and 503 server_is_overloaded errors
symptoms: 429 response with code slow_down even though the account is under its rate limit
Retry-After header present on some of these responses and ignored by custom retry code
cause: Since 2026-09-02 the API separates traffic that ramps up too fast (429, slow_down) from temporary model overload (503, server_is_overloaded). Handlers that treat every 429 as a hard quota failure, or that retry instantly, either give up early or hammer the API.
fix: Treat slow_down and server_is_overloaded as retryable. Wait at least the Retry-After value when present, otherwise use exponential backoff. Ramp traffic up gradually instead of in a sudden burst.
apply: delay = float(resp.headers.get("Retry-After", 0)) or min(60, 2 ** attempt)  # retry on 429 slow_down and 503 server_is_overloaded
